title: HackStorm 24-Hour Hackathon
description: Build a working prototype in 24 hours around the theme 'Tech for Campus'. Teams of up to 4. Prizes worth Rs. 50,000.

title: Intro to Machine Learning Workshop
description: A hands-on beginner workshop covering regression, classification and a mini project using Python and scikit-learn.

title: Annual Cultural Fest: Rang Tarang
description: Dance, music, drama and fashion show. Open to all students, with inter-college performances.

title: Inter-Department Cricket League
description: T10 knockout tournament between departments. Register your team of 11 plus 3 substitutes.

title: Resume & LinkedIn Masterclass
description: Learn how to write an ATS-friendly resume and build a standout LinkedIn profile, led by industry recruiters.

title: Quiz Mania 2026
description: General knowledge, tech and pop-culture rounds. Teams of 2. Exciting goodies for the top 3.

title: Startup Pitch Day
description: Student founders pitch to a panel of investors and mentors. Open for audience registration.

title: Web Development Bootcamp
description: Two-day bootcamp on HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Node.js. Build and deploy a full-stack app.

title: Photography Walk & Exhibition
description: Golden-hour campus photo walk followed by an exhibition of the best shots.

title: Cyber Security Awareness Seminar
description: Learn about phishing, password hygiene and safe browsing from certified security professionals.
